title: Interactive rebase
orderHint: Commits are applied top to bottom. Drag to reorder.

issue.empty: There are no commits to rebase.
issue.needsPreviousCommit: The first commit cannot be squash or fixup: there is no previous commit.
issue.rewordWithoutMessage: Write the new message for the commits marked as reword.
issue.dirtyTree: There are uncommitted changes. Turn on autostash or save them first.
issue.allDropped: All commits are dropped: the branch will match the base.
issue.needsForcePush: Some commits are already pushed: a force push with lease will be needed.
